title: Evidence record
description: One observation, pinned to where and when it was made. A finding may only cite evidence that exists here.

class.description: onchain is a direct node read and the only class that can carry a block pin by itself. explorer is Blockscout. aggregator is CoinGecko, DeFiLlama, GeckoTerminal and similar. derived is a computation over other records, which must be listed in derived_from.

method.description: eth_call, eth_getStorageAt, eth_getLogs, GET /api/v2/..., or the document title.

source_host.description: Bare host only. Never a full URL, which could carry a credential.

capability.description: Which provider capability served this, e.g. current_onchain_state or historical_state.

block.description: Required for onchain and explorer evidence when evidence.require_block_pin is on.

freshness.description: block_pinned is reproducible at that block. cached means the provider documents a cache. unknown_cache means it does not. Never label cached REST data as real time.

cache_note.description: What the provider documents about staleness, or that it documents nothing.

request.description: How to reproduce the observation. Redacted endpoint only.

result_summary.description: What was actually returned, in plain words.

raw_ref.description: Path to the stored raw response.

derived_from.description: Evidence ids this record was computed from.

provider_disagreement.description: Ids of records that disagree with this one. Keep both rather than picking a winner.
